name: Breaking Ice
source:
You and your new skating partner both had your previous partnerships blow up last year. Your partner retired after a horrific injury. Theirs ended in an ugly, publicized falling out. With the Global Games approaching, you decided to partner up and fight for your dream together.

There's just one problem: your teamwork is a disaster.

You barely know each other. Your partner is laser-focused on technical perfection but completely uninterested in chemistry. Your coach calls your performance "heartless and soulless." On the ice, you're supposed to portray romance. Off the ice, your partner has a strict no-dating rule.

But the only way to fix your lifeless routines is to break through their walls. Between practices, you convince them to spend time with you. These "teamwork excursions" start feeling like dates. Your feelings grow, and you're sure they feel it too, until they blow you off again.

With a spot on the Global Games on the line, you finally give your relationship a real chance. When your hearts sync up, the magic on ice is undeniable.
translation:
去年，你和你的新滑冰伙伴之前的合作关系都破裂了。你的伴侣在受了严重伤害后退休了。他们的争吵最终以丑陋、公开的争吵告终。随着全球运动会的临近，你们决定携手并进，共同为梦想而奋斗。

只有一个问题：你的团队合作是一场灾难。

你们几乎不认识对方。你的合作伙伴专注于技术完美，但对化学完全不感兴趣。你的教练称你的表现“无情且没有灵魂”。在冰上，你应该描绘浪漫。在冰场之外，你的伴侣有严格的禁止约会规则。

但改变你毫无生气的日常生活的唯一方法就是冲破它们的围墙。在练习间隙，你说服他们花时间和你在一起。这些“团队合作旅行”开始感觉像约会。你的感情会越来越强烈，而且你确信他们也会有这种感觉，直到他们再次让你失望。

有了参加全球运动会的机会，你终于给你们的关系一个真正的机会了。当你们的心同步时，冰上的魔力是不可否认的。
